popup.title: The Wide
popup.description: A district in the [[Upper City]] of [[Baldur's Gate]] that served as a vast open-air marketplace and plaza.

popup.title: Hissing Stones
popup.description: A bathhouse and a local landmark with a sterling reputation as the city's safest and most confidential meeting area among the various Baldurian power groups.

popup.title: Distant Shores
popup.description: A merchant of imported goods and products native to [[Chult]].

popup.title: Harbreeze Bakery
popup.description: A bakery offered such favorite delicacies as [[cinnamon]] [[cookie]]s and full loaves of [[sugarbread]] highlighted by the flavors of foreign [[tea]]s and [[spice]]s.

popup.title: Felogyr's Fireworks
popup.description: A four-story stone shop on [[Bindle Street]] that traded in [[fireworks]], [[torch]]es, [[candle]] wicks, and other lesser alchemical items, and as of the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]], the sole producer of [[smokepowder]] within [[Baldur's Gate]].

popup.title: Counting House
popup.description: The center of trade and business in [[Baldur's Gate]], serving as both a bank and establishment that facilitated the exchange of various currencies.

popup.title: Sorcerous Sundries
popup.description: A magic shop on [[Stormshore Street]] in the [[Heapside]] district.

popup.title: Eastway Expeditions
popup.description: A shop that specialized in selling equipment to those who sought exploration or adventure, particularly those ''en route'' to the [[Chultan Peninsula]].

popup.title: Candulhallow's Funeral Arrangements
popup.description: A city-sponsored business that specialized in the transportation and occasionally sale of corpses to cemeteries or temples.

popup.title: Danthelon's Dancing Axe
popup.description: A general store that sold good quality secondhand wares, from pots and pans to [[rope]], [[armor]], and [[weapons]].

popup.title: Hamhocks Slaughterhouse
popup.description: A massive compound composed of a number of animal pens, knackeries, and butcheries, its foul stench drove away the animals of the herders and wranglers.

popup.title: Garynmor Stables and Menagerie
popup.description: A business that specialized in the handling and care of mundane beasts of burden, as well as the exhibition of all manner of exotic and fantastical creatures.

popup.title: Calim Jewel Emporium
popup.description: Shop and home to the most well-regarded [[Baldurian]] jeweler of the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]] and a forum for local agents of the criminal organization known as [[the Guild]].

popup.title: Candlekeep Chandlery
popup.description: A shop that sold beautifying products and [[candle]]s, both mundane and magical in nature.

popup.title: Lucky Aello's Discount Store
popup.description: A store that sold heavily marked-down goods that ranged from [[potion]]s of reliable quality to ''[[curse]]d'' [[weapon]]s and [[scroll]]s of magic protection.{{approx}}

popup.title: Maltz's Weapon Shop
popup.description: A merchant who dealt in mandate weapons, ran by [[Maltz]] in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]], located just to the northwest of the [[Elfsong Tavern]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Well-Adjusted Al's General Store
popup.description: The general store located to the west of the [[Low Lantern]]; it traded in mundane goods and [[weapon]]s and run by eccentric [[Well-Adjusted Al]] in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Alabaster Stonecrafts
popup.description: An open-air stonemason's workshop run by twin [[dwarf|dwarven]] siblings in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Rivington General
popup.description: A smithy that dealt in [[weapon]]s and [[armor]], run by [[Gyldro Angleiron]] after [[1477 DR]]. Its shop area was a building to the north, with the southern connected structure being the workshop and the proprietor's home.{{approx}}

popup.title: Bonecloak's Apothecary
popup.description: A [[potion]] brewer's shop run by [[Derryth Bonecloak]] and [[Baelen Bonecloak]] ''circa'' [[1492 DR]].{{approx}}

popup.title: The Glitter Gala
popup.description: A shop that traded in [[gemstone]]s and jewelry from [[Amn]], [[Cormyr]], and [[Damara]] and shared the building with [[Chromatic Scale]] musical instrument shop.{{approx}}

popup.title: Chromatic Scale
popup.description: A shop that dealt in quality musical instruments, run by [[Thomas C. Quirkilious]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Facemaker's Boutique
popup.description: An upscale clothier, barber, makeup artist, stylist, and disguises shop.{{approx}}

popup.title: Crimson Draughts
popup.description: [[Araj Oblodra]]'s [[alchemist]] shop located on [[Stormshore Street]] across from [[Beehive Goods and Wares]] general store in the late 15{{th}} century DR.{{approx}}

popup.title: Beehive Goods and Wares
popup.description: A general store run by [[Oliver Tefoco]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]] and offered food, [[potion]]s, [[wine]]s, and some general miscellany.{{approx}}

popup.title: Sword Coast Couriers
popup.description: A courier, shipping, and postal agency that operated in the environs and within the city of [[Baldur's Gate]], located in the [[Rivington]] neighborhood in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].
